en.headline: Kai Tak Sports Park Halloween Party continues at Dining Cove through Saturday
en.dek: The free family- and pet-friendly event at the waterfront includes cosplay, live music, a marketplace and light installations on 30 and 31 October from 2pm to 11pm.
body: The Kai Tak Sports Park Halloween Party continues today and tomorrow at Dining Cove, with free admission from 2pm to 11pm.

Organisers said the waterfront block party features Halloween-inspired cosplay, live music and dance performances, neon light installations and a themed marketplace. It is described as pet- and family-friendly, with dedicated pet photo spots and cosplay artwork by local cosplayers.

The programme, which began earlier in the month with a flash mob at Kai Tak Mall, also includes a dynamic Halloween Pumpkin light show on the stadium façade and a giant Halloween Moon installation at Kai Tak Sports Avenue.

Local rapper Dan James is scheduled to perform on 31 October as part of the musical line-up that includes outdoor busking, DJ sets and street dance showcases. The event runs alongside other Halloween activities across the city.

zh.headline: 啟德體育園萬聖節派對美食海灣今明繼續
zh.dek: 免費親子及寵物友善活動於10月30及31日下午2時至晚上11時舉行，設有cosplay、現場音樂、市集及燈光裝置。
body: 啟德體育園萬聖節派對今日及明日繼續在美食海灣舉行，免費入場，時間由下午2時至晚上11時。
主辦單位表示，海濱街區派對設有以萬聖節為主題的cosplay、現場音樂及舞蹈表演、霓虹燈光裝置及主題市集，並歡迎寵物及家庭參與，設有寵物拍照點及本地cosplayer作品。
活動本月較早時已在啟德零售館以快閃活動揭幕，場內亦有體育場外牆的萬聖節南瓜燈光秀，以及啟德體育大道的巨型萬聖節月亮裝置。
本地rapper Dan James將於31日演出，節目亦包括戶外busking、DJ表演及街頭舞蹈展示。活動與全城其他萬聖節節目同期舉行。
